fieldValues.title: Computed values left to a model's judgement
fieldValues.statement: Values that should be counted from the evidence (how strong a signal is, how many sources support a claim, a rank) are written by the model, which inflates them. A reader sees a confident rating that no rule produced and no one can reproduce.
source_ref: srs-programme finding f3225366: asked to set LiveWyer's computed signal field, the model marked all eleven opportunities strong
